articles.title: Israel and Hezbollah agree ceasefire, US says, as more Lebanon strikes reported
articles.description: The agreement followed concerns that continued clashes would undermine the deal to end the war between the US and Iran.

articles.title: Moscow residents complain of black rain after largest Ukrainian attack hits oil refinery
articles.description: A refinery and a shopping centre burned after almost 200 Ukrainian drones were launched towards an area to the south-east of the Russian capital.

articles.title: Thirty-five killed as gunmen attack Niger's biggest airport
articles.description: Niger has been fighting a militant Islamist insurgency for a decade and in January suspected jihadists attacked the same airport.

articles.title: Bowen: US-Iran deal raises inescapable question of what the war was for
articles.description: While the human cost is clear, the Iranian regime has not just survived the war, it has been empowered.

articles.title: Hegseth renews Nato criticism and says US will review presence in Europe
articles.description: The US defence secretary's move follows a US decision to scale back its commitments to a high readiness force within the alliance.
